title: GVA physical cache alias on Mirror role switches
hypothesis: For a verified identical prefill trajectory with readout-only role m, 2 or 4 logical role switches preserve target logits within float32 atol=1e-4 and reuse a single physical cache allocation, while reducing combined resident-prefix bytes >=25% versus native per-role copies with P95 switch <=1.10 native GVA readout-switch control.
physical_object: one physically aliased grouped-V and positional-key prefix cache
mirror_coordinate: small readout m switched between compatible GVA attention roles without rebuilding prefix
logical_multiplicity: multiple logical role/readout functions reusing the same prefix tensors
closest_controls: native GVA role switch / eager copies / target re-prefill / MA-691 alias

requirements.native: Build native GVA prefix once. Compare zero-switch, per-role copied caches, native per-role full GVA M_h without m, lazy algebraic transform, re-prefill, and proposed structured readout m. Do not compare to a purposefully inefficient memcpy-only strawman as the main control.
requirements.insertion: Change only the query-side reconstruction/readout code m after a frozen prefix; physically alias the exact V_cache/Kpos buffers. If m also changes past hidden activations, mark prefix INCOMPATIBLE and re-prefill; do not translate without a separately verified mapper.
requirements.method: In 4-head 2-group GVA, construct three switch conditions: (A) identical prefix content/weights with readout-only m (exactly safe), (B) compatible invertible readout changes with explicit conjugation/commutant check, (C) upstream attention weights changed during prefill (unsafe). Trace data_ptr and allocator counts, tensor lifetime/refcounts and copy-on-write; compare each target to true target re-prefill. Include batch fork/cold/warm cache and RoPE offset changes.
requirements.fixture: Frozen tiny decoder with deterministic 128/256 token prefixes and switch at 32/64/128 tokens, 2 and 4 roles, heldout source prompts. No training is needed for algebraic case; a separately pretrained tiny GVA is required for learned-role quality.
requirements.hardware: Stage 1 CPU PyTorch contiguous tensor pointers and byte storage; optional CUDA GPU for actual VRAM `max_memory_allocated` with explicit synchronize, report device, dtype, batch and context.

development.allowed: select code dimension, LR, stop condition only

resources.compute: training examples and updates, FLOPs or MACs, CPU/GPU P50/P95 with batch/dtype/hardware
resources.quality: Exact target logits/NLL, heap/VRAM allocation and alias pointers, prefix bytes, TTFT, 50/95/99% switching time, synchronization, additional FLOPs, prefill copies, buffer fork counts.

gates.PASS: All five fresh prompt seeds case A and B meet target-logit atol=1e-4 float32 and actual alias equality with no prefix copies; vs real independent per-role caches physical bytes <=0.75 and measured P95 switch <=1.10 native GVA role-read baseline. Case C MUST be detected as unsafe, not counted as shared.
gates.FAIL: Case C incorrectly declared safe, any prefix copy called alias, quality drift exceeds tolerance in case A, or native GVA readout handles switches equally well at lower memory/latency.
gates.UNCERTAIN: Missing strong control, uncertain precision, insufficient heldout data, unmeasured runtime or CI overlap

alternative: Exact algebra at an attention readout does not imply cache equivalence after different upstream hidden states; native GVA with shared heads may already provide the same alias.
uncertainty: Allocator caching and tensor view alias semantics, async GPU timing synchronization, RoPE offset and token provenance, copy-on-write, model training differences; log device allocator behavior and confidence interval over prompts.
stopping: Stop after 3 dev seeds then 5 fresh worlds; if cheap mechanism fails predeclared gate, record negative and do not tune fresh. Hardware unavailable => BLOCKED (not PASS).
prior_art_delta: Separate algebraic query-side readout switching from physically shared cache and show precisely when a changed upstream hidden trajectory invalidates the prefix.
limitations: Never extrapolate from identical-prefix readout-only compatibility to cross-model or independently generated prefixes.
